Task T1 is complete. Summary:

- **`out/T1/solution.py`**: loads the sharded checkpoint via `model.safetensors.index.json`, rebuilds a fresh state dict (never renaming in place, so old/new layer indices can't collide), drops blocks 2/6/10/14, remaps survivors to 0–11 in original order, and runs the three required checks (no blocks 12–15, exactly 12 contiguous blocks, exactly 86 tensors) before writing anything — raising and deleting any partial output on failure.
- **`out/T1/run.sh`**: invokes it with the repo's `.venv/bin/python`.
- Ran once, succeeded on the first execution; independently verified bit-exact equality of every remapped tensor against the source and confirmed the two non-block tensors (`embed_tokens`, `lm_head`) are untouched.
- **`out/T1/REPORT.md`**: filled in per `record-template.md`, naming `safetensors`/`torch` as the tools used and why a plain script was chosen over `mergekit`/`torch-state-bridge`.
